🔥 Incredible footage of VOLCANIC ERUPTION of a dormant Volcano in Ethiopia from a commercial plane.

🌋 Countries where Deadliest Volcanic Eruptions in Recorded History 🗻

1. Tambora 🇮🇩 Indonesia – 1815 → ~92,000 deaths

2. Huaynaputina 🇵🇪 Peru – 1600 → ~41,000–50,000 deaths

3. Krakatau 🇮🇩 Indonesia – 1883 → ~36,000 deaths

4. Mount Pelée 🇲🇶 Martinique – 1902 → ~30,000 deaths

5. Nevado del Ruiz 🇨🇴 Colombia – 1985 → ~23,000–25,000 deaths

6. Unzen (Mayuyama) 🇯🇵 Japan – 1792 → ~15,000 deaths

7. Kelud 🇮🇩 Indonesia – 1586 → ~10,000 deaths

8. Laki 🇮🇸 Iceland – 1783–84 → ~9,350 deaths

9. Santa María 🇬🇹 Guatemala – 1902 → ~5,000–6,000 deaths

10. Vesuvius 🇮🇹 Italy – 1631 → ~4,000–6,000 deaths

11. Awu 🇮🇩 Indonesia – 1812 → ~3,500 deaths

12. Vesuvius 🇮🇹 Italy – 79 AD (Pompeii) → ~3,000–16,000 deaths (estimates vary)

13. Papandayan 🇮🇩 Indonesia – 1772 → ~3,000 deaths

14. Lamington 🇵🇬 Papua New Guinea – 1951 → ~2,942 deaths

15. El Chichón 🇲🇽 Mexico – 1982 → ~2,000–3,500 deaths

16. Soufrière Hills 🇲🇸 Montserrat (UK) – 1995–ongoing → ~2,000 displaced + many deaths

17. Komagatake 🇯🇵 Japan – 1640 → ~2,000 deaths

18. Ruiz (again) 🇨🇴 Colombia – 1845 → ~1,000–2,000 deaths

19. Taal 🇵🇭 Philippines – 1911 → ~1,335 deaths

20. Galunggung 🇮🇩 Indonesia – 1822 → ~4,000 deaths

(Most of the deadliest ones are in the Ring of Fire!)

(QA sight seen for the first time in recorded history.)
